test_soft_embedding_shape: test that Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder projects soft audio embeddings to the correct output shape
test_hard_embedding_shape: test that Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder embeds and projects hard audio token IDs correctly
test_projection_dimensions: test that the embedding projection maps from audio hidden size to text model dimension
test_vocab_size: test that the embedding table has the correct vocabulary size of 128 audio tokens
test_different_norms_for_hard_soft: test that hard and soft embeddings use separate RMSNorm instances and produce different outputs
